name: sdlxliff-translator-fr
description: Translate and QA SDL Trados SDLXLIFF files with Claude. Fully offline: French typography checks, offline spellcheck, and invisible local version history with one-step undo.
long_description:
An MCP server for English→French translation work on SDLXLIFF files (SDL Trados Studio format), reworked from EugeneAnt/mcp-server-sdlxliff for confidential translation workflows.

Everything runs locally — no network access, no telemetry, no data ever leaves your machine.

Features:

- Extract translation segments with source/target text and status
- Update translations with automatic tag preservation and atomic saves
- Paginated reading for large files
- Invisible version history: every save keeps a local snapshot automatically; review what changed segment by segment or undo a save in one step (no git installation required, history never leaves your machine)
- QA checks including French typography (non-breaking spaces before : ; ! ?, « guillemets », French number formatting) with FR-FR and FR-CA conventions
- Offline spelling check (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch)
- Glossary/terminology compliance checking

Designed for use with Claude Cowork to translate and review SDLXLIFF files.

tools.name: read_sdlxliff
